name: Colorlib
summary: Free WordPress themes plus a library of 1,000+ commercial HTML/Bootstrap website templates and free snippets.
description: Colorlib publishes free WordPress themes and a large library of HTML/Bootstrap website templates, organised by type and industry (business, portfolio, e-commerce, restaurant, landing page, one page, Astro ...) with curated collections and website-example galleries. The HTML templates are commercial products ($19 single, $129/year all-access, $349 lifetime); WordPress themes, HTML/CSS code snippets (CC BY 3.0) and blog tutorials are free.
contains: 1,000+ HTML/Bootstrap website templates; commercial ($19 single, $129/year, $349 lifetime)
50+ free WordPress themes; 10M+ total template downloads
100+ website example galleries and theme collections by industry
free HTML/CSS code snippets (forms, tables, carousels, progress bars) under CC BY 3.0
blog with tutorials, theme roundups, plugin reviews and design inspiration
licence: templates usable on own and client sites, no resale or redistribution
